title: System Behavior Map Static Inventory and Regression Gate

permissions.reason: This maintenance capability inventories existing authorization evidence but adds no runtime permission or user authorization behavior.

frontend.reason: The capability generates CI/static-analysis artifacts and has no user-facing route, page, menu, form or browser surface.

database.reason: No product database model or persisted business data changes are made.

migration.reason: No database schema or runtime permission migration is introduced.

permissions.reason: The inventory reports permission evidence but does not create or modify permissions.

backend.reason: Production backend executable behavior is intentionally unchanged; backend source is read statically by tooling only.

api.reason: No HTTP endpoint or API contract is changed.

tenant_isolation.reason: No production tenant-owned query or mutation behavior is changed; the tool only reports static scope evidence.

audit.reason: No business mutation or runtime side effect is introduced.

frontend.reason: No rendered frontend behavior is changed; frontend source is read statically by tooling only.

ui_permissions.reason: No user-facing UI authorization behavior is changed.

menu.reason: No navigation entry is added or changed.

route_guard.reason: No frontend route or route guard is added or changed.

forms.reason: No user form behavior is involved.

visual_qa.reason: There is no rendered UI surface to visually verify.

frontend_tests.reason: No frontend executable behavior is changed.

runtime_authorization.reason: No runtime authentication or authorization boundary is changed.

runtime_verification.reason: Repository static-analysis CI execution is the acceptance surface for this maintenance capability; runtime behavior coverage will be a separate follow-up layer.

deployment.reason: Repository scripts and GitHub Actions require no application runtime deployment.

notes: The canonical reusable behavior-map semantics live in kyrox-platform; this contract covers the Fair CRM-specific extraction/enforcement implementation. The first phase compares PR-base vs current finding signatures so existing unknowns remain visible but no new unmapped/drift finding can be introduced. Runtime/cross-organization coverage is intentionally a separate later phase and is not claimed by this contract.
